final: WITH s AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) AS share FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), a AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS avg_share FROM s) SELECT SUM(n) AS total_telescopes, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM a)
